action_summary: Does the pre-registered next step: construct the observable for the actions whose deciding fact no cheap sensor can see. On 160 real states of 10 real actions (git, tar, gzip, chmod, patch), a check mode is DISCOVERED from the program's own page -- most specific help first, three declared rewrites of the action's own argv with the options that page prints, a read-only requirement, and agreement with the action's own exit status on training states -- then scored on held-out states.
